newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- An Iraqi trade delegation begins talks with Syrian officials and businessmen.
- Kuwaiti acting prime minister rules out dissolving parliament.
- A Chinese trade team is visiting Cairo to discuss setting up a free trade zone between the two countries.
- Dubai emirate in the United Arab Emirates imported gold worth $1.7 billion in the first quarter of 1997.
- King Fahd receives U.S. defence minister Cohen.
- Qatari investors seek establishing new hotels in Jordan.
